finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

interaction_target.description: Creature this Charisma check socially interacts with; saved Charm Advantage is derived automatically.

award_id.description: Stable milestone ID, or unique XP event ID.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

evidence.description: Played event satisfying the policy, including allocation.

xp.description: Allocated XP for this character; 0 for milestones.

hound_bite_choices.description: Optional Hound target intent; actual enemies, range and Cover are derived.

area_object_targets.description: Actual scenery selected by the GM as lying in the spell's area.

caster.description: Validated character ID for a Player Character or Companion; omit for a prepared NPC.

caster_can_touch_target.description: For a Touch spell on another creature without engine-derived combat range, supply true only when the caster can touch that target now; false means it is out of touch reach. Self-touch is automatic.

contingent_fact_tag.description: A selected narrative occurrence tag; mechanical HP/save/hit/condition outcomes use native events.

fire_bolt_object_facts.description: Outside combat, establish one actual Fire Bolt object receiver's current place, caster/current and object planes, distance, sight, categorical Cover and whether a nonincapacitated enemy within five feet can see the caster. Admit the actual object and classify its native material/size/durability; record combustibility and ordinary fuel facts before casting. Combat ignores these fictional facts.

fire_storm_cubes.description: Fire Storm only: each aligned 10-foot cube has min [x,y,z], origin [x,y,z] on a face, and include_origin. Set origin_unseen true for an unseen point; a blocked origin forms on the near side of the first solid obstruction, translating that cube. Actual scene recipients and ignition are derived before payment. For Cover that varies by cube origin, admit target scene metadata.cover_from_points rows with point [x,y,z], plane, and cover (none, half, three_quarters, or total).

healing_allocations.description: For a fixed healing pool, HP amounts assigned in the same order as targets; the engine checks their sum.

ice_storm_ground_zone_ids.description: Actual ground zones the GM identifies as affected by Ice Storm's Cylinder.

material_component_available.description: For a required Material component, confirm the selected supply can be accessed with a hand or used as its focus description allows.

material_item_ids.description: Saved spell_materials supply IDs to use. Actual carried inventory, unit quantities, value, component compatibility and focus permission are checked. Never substitute a pouch/focus for priced or consumed material.

shatter_object_targets.description: Actual objects the GM identifies as lying in Shatter's ten-foot Sphere.

sleepless_targets.description: Selected Sleep targets whose admitted creature/species traits say they do not sleep.

slot_resource.description: Required for characters. Use feature for a saved source's free cast at the spell's base level. Omit for NPCs, whose casting level and uses come from their saved stat block.

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

spell_grant.description: Choose the saved source when more than one class, feat or lineage grants this spell.

summon_distance.description: Distance from the caster to the creature's unoccupied space in feet.

summon_id.description: New persistent entity ID for a spell-created creature.

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

thunderwave_unsecured_objects.description: Actual unsecured objects the GM identifies as entirely inside the Cube.

travel_exploration_destinations.description: For Misty Step outside combat, supply exactly one established destination fact record: its named place, actual current_plane and destination plane, horizontal_distance_feet, signed elevation_change_feet (negative means downward), visible and unoccupied. Do not invent these facts; the destination must be on the current plane and within the original 30-foot straight-line range, including either upward or downward elevation. Combat ignores this record and uses travel_destination and the saved scene.

true_strike_weapon.description: Choose only a weapon established in the active actor's authoritative inventory. Use the canonical singular weapon ID; an inventory entry of darts authorizes dart.

verbal_component_available.description: Required for a spell with a Verbal component unless the saved NPC stat block waives it. True only if the caster can speak normally and is not gagged or in magical silence.

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

attack_distance.description: Actual distance to this target in feet.

attack_modifier.description: Signed d20 attack modifier from the admitted creature stat block or GM adaptation.

attack_name.description: Plain attack label from the admitted creature stat block or the GM's stated adaptation.

damage_expression.description: Damage dice only; select one exact enum value and do not include a modifier.

damage_modifier.description: Signed flat damage modifier applied after the damage dice.

long_range.description: Maximum ranged distance; for melee use the same value as normal_range.

normal_range.description: Melee reach or normal ranged distance in feet from the stat block or stated adaptation.

target.description: Exact authoritative entity ID of the living attack target; do not use its display name.

use_multiattack.description: Use a remaining named component of the creature's prepared Multiattack; true on every attack in that routine.

caster.description: Validated character ID for a Player Character or Companion; omit for a prepared NPC.

contingent_fact_tag.description: A selected narrative occurrence tag; mechanical HP/save/hit/condition outcomes use native events.

                value:
                  flags:
                  - '"sideways"'
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            - set:
                field: _riichi_marker
                value: false
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: state.last_discard != null and _discard.tile == state.last_discard.tile
              and not _discard.claimed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _flag
                value:
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
                  flags: joined(_piece.flags, one('latest'))
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value: merge(_piece, _flag)
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _pieces
            value: _piece
    - set:
        field: _discard_group
        value:
          id: '"discards"'
          label: '"Discards"'
          role: '"pond"'
          visibility: '"public"'
          pieces: _pieces
    - set:
        field: _regular
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _drawn_pieces
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _rack_pieces
        value: _hand.pieces
    - for_each:
        collection: _rack_pieces
        as: _rack_piece
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: '''drawn'' in _rack_piece.flags'
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _drawn_pieces
                value: _rack_piece
            on_false:
            - list_push:
                list: _regular
                value: _rack_piece
    - set:
        field: _complete_hand
        value:
          pieces: joined(_regular, _drawn_pieces)
    - set:
        field: _hand
        value: merge(_hand, _complete_hand)
    - set:
        field: _groups
        value:
        - _hand
        - _discard_group
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - set:
        field: _index
        value: 0
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _pieces
            value: []
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: ordered(_meld.tiles)
        - set:
            field: _called
            value: -1
        - set:
            field: _added
            value: -1
        - set:
            field: _offset
            value: (_meld.source_seat - actor.seat + 4) % 4
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.opened
            on_true:
            - condition:
                condition: 'true'
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _argument_actor
                    value: state.seats[_meld.source_seat]
                - call: _discard_history
                  params:
                    actor: '{_argument_actor}'
                  export_context:
                    _source_discards: _source_discards
                on_false: []
            - for_each:
                collection: _source_discards
                as: _source_discard
                do:
                - condition:
                    condition: _source_discard.claimed and _source_discard.tile in
                      _meld.tiles
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _called
                        value: _source_discard.tile
                    on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _meld.quad and _called != _meld.tiles[3]
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _added
                    value: _meld.tiles[3]
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _normal
            value: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _tiles
            as: _normal_tile
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _normal_tile != _called and _normal_tile != _added
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _normal
                    value: _normal_tile
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _ordered
            value: _tiles
        - condition:
            condition: not _meld.opened and definitions.tiles[_tiles[0]].red
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _ordered
                value:
                - _tiles[1]
                - _tiles[0]
                - _tiles[2]
                - _tiles[3]
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _called >= 0
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _slot
                value: 0
            - condition:
                condition: _offset == 1
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _slot
                    value: len(_normal)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _offset == 2
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _slot
                    value: 1
                on_false: []
            - set:
                field: _ordered
                value: joined(joined(portion(_normal, 0, _slot), one(_called)), portion(_normal,
                  _slot, len(_normal)))
            on_false: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _ordered
            as: _tile
            do:
            - set:
                field: _piece
                value:
                  id: '''meld:'' + text(_tile)'
                  label: definitions.tiles[_tile].label
                  face: definitions.tiles[_tile].face
                  flags: []
            - condition:
                condition: _tile == _called
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _flag
                    value:
                      flags:
                      - '"sideways"'
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, _flag)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: not _meld.opened and (_tile == _ordered[0] or _tile ==
                  _ordered[3])
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _flag
                    value:
                      flags:
                      - '"back"'
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, _flag)
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: definitions.tiles[_tile].red
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _piece
                    value: merge(_piece, definitions.red_presentation)
                on_false: []
            - list_push:
                list: _pieces
                value: _piece
            - condition:
                condition: _tile == _called and _added >= 0
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _pieces
                    value:
                      id: '''meld:'' + text(_added)'
                      label: definitions.tiles[_added].label
                      face: definitions.tiles[_added].face
                      flags:
                      - '"stacked"'
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _label
            value: '"Pon"'
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.form == 'sequence'
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _label
                value: '"Chi"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.quad
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _label
                value: '"Open kan"'
            - condition:
                condition: not _meld.opened
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _label
                    value: '"Concealed kan"'
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        - list_push:
            list: _groups
            value:
              id: '''meld:'' + text(_index)'
              label: _label
              role: '"meld"'
              source: definitions.call_sources[_offset]
              visibility: '"public"'
              pieces: _pieces
        - set:
            field: _index
            value: _index + 1
    - set:
        field: _seat_label
        value: actor.name + ' / ' + definitions.seat_winds[(actor.seat - state.dealer
          + 4) % 4]
    - condition:
        condition: actor.game.riichi
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _seat_label
            value: _seat_label + ' / Riichi'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.result != null and state.result.kind == 'draw'
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: actor.game.revealed
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _seat_label
                value: _seat_label + ' / Tenpai'
            on_false:
            - set:
                field: _seat_label
                value: _seat_label + ' / Noten'
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _area
        value:
          id: _actor_id
          label: _seat_label
          position: definitions.positions[actor.seat]
          badge: definitions.wind_glyphs[(actor.seat - state.dealer + 4) % 4]
          score: text(actor.score)
          active: _actor_id == state.actor and not state.finished
          groups: _groups
    narrative: {}
  _center_table:
    description: Package-owned center table.
    parameters: []
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _dora
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _visible_indicators
        value: 1 + state.kan_count - state.kan_pending_dora
    - condition:
        condition: state.phase == 'kan_response' and state.pending_kan.op == 'ankan'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _visible_indicators
            value: _visible_indicators + 1
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _indexes
        value: indices(_visible_indicators)
    - for_each:
        collection: _indexes
        as: _index
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _dora
            value:
              id: '''dora:'' + text(_index)'
              label: definitions.tiles[state.dead[4 + _index * 2]].label
              face: definitions.tiles[state.dead[4 + _index * 2]].face
    - call: _choice_table
      params:
        actor: '{state.actor}'
      export_context:
        _options: _options
        _turn: _turn
    - set:
        field: _info
        value:
        - id: '"message"'
          label: state.message
    - condition:
        condition: state.finished and state.match_result != null
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _standings
            value: state.match_result.standings
        - for_each:
            collection: _standings
            as: _standing
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _info
                value:
                  id: '''place:'' + text(_standing.seat)'
                  label: 'text(_standing.rank) + ''. '' + _standing.name + '': ''
                    + text(_standing.points)'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.pending_kan != null and state.phase == 'kan_response'
        on_true:
        - list_push:
            list: _info
            value:
              id: '"kan"'
              label: '''Kan declared: '' + definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].label'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.result != null and state.result.kind == 'win'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _wins
            value: state.result.winners
        - for_each:
            collection: _wins
            as: _win
            do:
            - set:
                field: _score_summary
                value: text(_win.score.han) + ' han / ' + text(_win.score.fu) + '
                  fu; ' + 'dora ' + text(_win.score.dora) + ', red ' + text(_win.score.red)
                  + ', ura ' + text(_win.score.ura)
            - condition:
                condition: _win.score.yakuman_units > 0
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _score_summary
                    value: text(_win.score.yakuman_units) + ' yakuman'
                on_false: []
            - list_push:
                list: _info
                value:
                  id: '''winner:'' + text(_win.seat)'
                  label: _win.name + ' +' + text(_win.gain)
                  detail: _score_summary
                  emphasis: '"accent"'
            - set:
                field: _yaku
                value: _win.score.yaku
            - set:
                field: _index
                value: 0
            - for_each:
                collection: _yaku
                as: _label
                do:
                - list_push:
                    list: _info
                    value:
                      id: '''yaku:'' + text(_win.seat) + '':'' + text(_index)'
                      label: _label
                - set:
                    field: _index
                    value: _index + 1
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _center
        value:
          id: '"shared"'
          label: _turn
          position: '"center"'
          groups:
          - id: '"dora"'
            label: '"Dora indicators"'
            role: '"indicators"'
            visibility: '"public"'
            pieces: _dora
          - id: '"choices"'
            label: '"Actions"'
            role: '"actions"'
            visibility: '"public"'
            pieces: _options
          - id: '"result"'
            label: '"Table"'
            role: '"message"'
            visibility: '"public"'
            pieces: _info
    narrative: {}
  _choice_table:
    description: Package-owned choice table.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _turn
        value: actor.name + ' to act'
    - condition:
        condition: state.phase == 'hand_end'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _turn
            value: '"Hand complete"'
        on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: state.phase == 'finished'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _turn
            value: '"Match complete"'
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _options
        value: []
    - condition:
        condition: actor.control == 'player'
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _choices
            value: state.choices
        - for_each:
            collection: _choices
            as: _choice
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _choice.op != 'discard'
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _faces
                    value: []
                - set:
                    field: _choice_tiles
                    value: _choice.tiles
                - for_each:
                    collection: _choice_tiles
                    as: _choice_tile
                    do:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _faces
                        value: definitions.tiles[_choice_tile].face
                - condition:
                    condition: _choice.op == 'chi' or _choice.op == 'pon' or _choice.op
                      == 'minkan'
                    on_true:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _faces
                        value: definitions.tiles[state.last_discard.tile].face
                    on_false: []
                - list_push:
                    list: _options
                    value:
                      id: _choice.id
                      label: definitions.action_labels[_choice.op]
                      detail: _choice.label
                      faces: _faces
                      action_id: '"play"'
                on_false: []
        on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _waits:
    description: Package-owned waits.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: tiles
      type: array
      items:
        type: integer
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _kinds
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _waits
        value: completions(_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)],
          indices(34))
    - set:
        field: _pairs
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _singles
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _terminals
        value: []
    - set:
        field: _types
        value: indices(34)
    - set:
        field: _only_terminals
        value: true
    - for_each:
        collection: _types
        as: _kind
        do:
        - set:
            field: _count
            value: occurrences(_kinds, _kind)
        - condition:
            condition: _count == 2
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _pairs
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _count == 1
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _singles
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _count > 0
            on_true:
            - condition:
                condition: _kind in definitions.terminals
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _terminals
                    value: _kind
                on_false:
                - set:
                    field: _only_terminals
                    value: false
            on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: len(actor.game.melds) == 0
        on_true:
        - condition:
            condition: len(_pairs) == 6 and len(_singles) == 1
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _waits
                value: _singles[0]
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and len(_terminals) == 13
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _waits
                value: definitions.terminals
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and len(_terminals) == 12 and len(_pairs) ==
              1
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _missing
                value: without(definitions.terminals, _terminals)
            - list_push:
                list: _waits
                value: _missing[0]
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _all
        value: _kinds
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _meld_tiles
            value: _meld.tiles
        - for_each:
            collection: _meld_tiles
            as: _tile
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _all
                value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _filtered
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _waits
        as: _kind
        do:
        - condition:
            condition: occurrences(_all, _kind) < 4 and _kind not in _filtered
            on_true:
            - list_push:
                list: _filtered
                value: _kind
            on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _waits
        value: _filtered
    narrative: {}
  _score_hand:
    description: Package-owned score hand.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: winning_tile
      type: integer
    - name: is_tsumo
      type: boolean
    - name: win_source
      type: string
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _score
        value:
          valid: false
          total: 0
          han: 0
          fu: 0
          basic: 0
          yakuman_units: 0
          yaku: []
          dora: 0
          red: 0
          ura: 0
    - set:
        field: _closed_tiles
        value: actor.game.hand
    - condition:
        condition: not is_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _closed_tiles
            value: joined(_closed_tiles, one(winning_tile))
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _kinds
        value: []
    - for_each:
        collection: _closed_tiles
        as: _tile
        do:
        - list_push:
            list: _kinds
            value: definitions.tiles[_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _winning_kind
        value: definitions.tiles[winning_tile].kind
    - set:
        field: _patterns
        value: partitions(_kinds, definitions.patterns, definitions.group_sizes[len(actor.game.melds)])
    - for_each:
        collection: _patterns
        as: _partition
        do:
        - set:
            field: _groups
            value: []
        - for_each:
            collection: _partition
            as: _pattern
            do:
            - condition:
                condition: _pattern < 34
                on_true:
                - list_push:
                    list: _groups
                    value:
                      form: '"pair"'
                      base: _pattern
                      opened: false
                      quad: false
                on_false:
                - condition:
                    condition: _pattern < 68
                    on_true:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _groups
                        value:
                          form: '"triplet"'
                          base: _pattern - 34
                          opened: false
                          quad: false
                    on_false:
                    - list_push:
                        list: _groups
                        value:
                          form: '"sequence"'
                          base: definitions.sequence_starts[_pattern - 68]
                          opened: false
                          quad: false
        - set:
            field: _closed_count
            value: len(_groups)
        - set:
            field: _melds
            value: actor.game.melds
        - for_each:
            collection: _melds
            as: _meld
            do:
            - list_push:
                list: _groups
                value:
                  form: _meld.form
                  base: _meld.base
                  opened: _meld.opened
                  quad: _meld.quad
        - set:
            field: _placements
            value: indices(_closed_count)
        - for_each:
            collection: _placements
            as: _placement
            do:
            - set:
                field: _group
                value: _groups[_placement]
            - condition:
                condition: (_group.form == 'sequence' and _winning_kind >= _group.base
                  and _winning_kind <= _group.base + 2) or (_group.form != 'sequence'
                  and _winning_kind == _group.base)
                on_true:
                - call: _score_shape
                  params:
                    actor: '{_actor_id}'
                    winning_tile: '{winning_tile}'
                    is_tsumo: '{is_tsumo}'
                    win_source: '{win_source}'
                    groups: '{_groups}'
                    placement: '{_placement}'
                    shape: standard
                  export_context:
                    _candidate: _candidate
                - condition:
                    condition: (_candidate.valid and not _score.valid) or (_candidate.valid
                      == _score.valid and (_candidate.total > _score.total or (_candidate.total
                      == _score.total and (_candidate.yakuman_units > _score.yakuman_units
                      or (_candidate.yakuman_units == _score.yakuman_units and _candidate.han
                      > _score.han)))))
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _score
                        value: _candidate
                    on_false: []
                on_false: []
    - condition:
        condition: len(actor.game.melds) == 0 and len(_closed_tiles) == 14
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _pair_count
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _distinct_terminals
            value: 0
        - set:
            field: _only_terminals
            value: true
        - set:
            field: _types
            value: indices(34)
        - for_each:
            collection: _types
            as: _kind
            do:
            - set:
                field: _count
                value: occurrences(_kinds, _kind)
            - condition:
                condition: _count == 2
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _pair_count
                    value: _pair_count + 1
                on_false: []
            - condition:
                condition: _count > 0
                on_true:
                - condition:
                    condition: _kind in definitions.terminals
                    on_true:
                    - set:
                        field: _distinct_terminals
                        value: _distinct_terminals + 1
                    on_false:
                    - set:
                        field: _only_terminals
                        value: false
                on_false: []
        - set:
            field: _shape
            value: null
        - condition:
            condition: _pair_count == 7
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _shape
                value: '"seven_pairs"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _only_terminals and _distinct_terminals == 13
            on_true:
            - set:
                field: _shape
                value: '"orphans"'
            on_false: []
        - condition:
            condition: _shape != null
            on_true:
            - call: _score_shape
              params:
                actor: '{_actor_id}'
                winning_tile: '{winning_tile}'
                is_tsumo: '{is_tsumo}'
                win_source: '{win_source}'
                groups: []
                placement: -1
                shape: '{_shape}'
              export_context:
                _candidate: _candidate
            - condition:
                condition: (_candidate.valid and not _score.valid) or (_candidate.valid
                  == _score.valid and (_candidate.total > _score.total or (_candidate.total
                  == _score.total and (_candidate.yakuman_units > _score.yakuman_units
                  or (_candidate.yakuman_units == _score.yakuman_units and _candidate.han
                  > _score.han)))))
                on_true:
                - set:
                    field: _score
                    value: _candidate
                on_false: []
            on_false: []
        on_false: []
    narrative: {}
  _score_shape:
    description: Package-owned score shape.
    parameters:
    - name: actor
      type: entity_id
      resolve: entity
    - name: winning_tile
      type: integer
    - name: is_tsumo
      type: boolean
    - name: win_source
      type: string
    - name: groups
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
    - name: placement
      type: integer
    - name: shape
      type: string
    pre_conditions: []
    effects:
    - set:
        field: _closed
        value: true
    - set:
        field: _tiles
        value: actor.game.hand
    - condition:
        condition: not is_tsumo
        on_true:
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: joined(_tiles, one(winning_tile))
        on_false: []
    - set:
        field: _melds
        value: actor.game.melds
    - for_each:
        collection: _melds
        as: _meld
        do:
        - set:
            field: _tiles
            value: joined(_tiles, _meld.tiles)
        - condition:
            condition: _meld.opened
            on_true:
            - set:
