sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
  - name: Intrusion
    description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
  - name: Field Medicine
    description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor: {namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static, key: state.active_actor}
  actor_entities: {namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static, key: state.entities}
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values: [player]
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
      - name: program
        type: string
        required: true
      - name: amount
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        required: true
      - name: charge_cost
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: multiplier
        type: integer
        required: true
      - name: family
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - add_stress
          - clear_interference
        required: true
    effects:
      - decrement:
          field: state.resources.charge
          amount: charge_cost
      - set:
          field: state.last_program.name
          value: program
      - set:
          field: state.last_program.result
          value: amount * multiplier
      - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
        on_true:
          - set:
              field: state.conditions.interference
              value: false
      - condition: family == 'add_stress'
        on_true:
          - increment:
              field: state.stress
              amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
      - name: skill
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - intrusion
          - field_medicine
      - name: pressure
        type: integer
        required: true
    effects:
      - dice:
          expression: 2d6
        store_as: _operation_roll
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.skill
          value: skill
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.total
          value: _operation_roll.total
      - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
        on_true:
          - set:
              field: state.last_check.outcome
              value: clear
        on_false:
          - set:
              field: state.last_check.outcome
              value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
      - name: stress
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: wounds
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: charge_spent
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
      - name: progress
        type: integer
        minimum: 0
        required: true
    effects:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: stress
      - increment:
          field: state.wounds
          amount: wounds
      - decrement:
          field: state.resources.charge
          amount: charge_spent
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: true
      - increment:
          field: state.advancement.intrusion
          amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
      - name: program
        type: enum
        enum_values:
          - ghost_route
          - signal_boost
        required: true
      - name: amount
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        required: true
    effects:
      - table_lookup:
          table: definitions.programs
          key: program
          required: true
          exact_selector: true
        store_as: _definition
      - set:
          field: _definition_key
          value: program
      - set:
          field: _definition_table
          value: programs
      - call: commit_program
        params:
          program: "{program}"
          amount: "{amount}"
          charge_cost: "{_definition.charge_cost}"
          multiplier: "{_definition.multiplier}"
          family: "{_definition.family}"
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost: {type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 5}
          multiplier: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 5}
        required: [charge_cost, multiplier]
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost: {type: integer, minimum: 0, maximum: 5}
          multiplier: {type: integer, minimum: 1, maximum: 5}
        required: [charge_cost, multiplier]
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
- name: Intrusion
  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3

  skills_enabled: 9.2e+18
  custom_flag: 9.2e+18

  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
- name: Intrusion
  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}
conditions:
- name: Hurt
  description: d
  mechanical_effect: m
  levels:
  - level: '1.00'
    effect: e

diagnostics.guidance: Read the package_runtime content definition and correct this field.

  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}
abilities:
  str:
    name: Strength
    default_min: '1_0.0'

diagnostics.message: Correct this field to satisfy the definition's anyOf constraint.
diagnostics.guidance: Read the package_runtime content definition and correct this field.

    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}
abilities: []

  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    - trigger:
        trigger: ''
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
- name: Intrusion
  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false

    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}
on_true: 0

  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
- name: Intrusion
  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier: null
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: 2.5
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
      on_true: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
- name: Intrusion
  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment: 1
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression:
        - a
        - a
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object

            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false

  programs:
    ghost_route:

      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3

    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - -1
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false: 0
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects: state.x
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

skills:
- name: Intrusion
  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters:
    - name: skill
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - intrusion
      - field_medicine
    - name: pressure
      type: integer
      required: true
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - - 1
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}

sylvia_gm_runtime:
  format: 1
  state_namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
skills:
- name: Intrusion
  description: Enter or reshape a hostile signal environment.
- name: Field Medicine
  description: Stabilize an operator under pressure.
model_decision_boundary:
  active_actor:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.active_actor
  actor_entities:
    namespace: sylvia-gm.conformance.signal-static
    key: state.entities
  participant_control:
    field: control_owner
    player_values:
    - player
  default_owner: gm
tools:
  commit_program:
    description: Apply one already-selected signal program family.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: string
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
      bogus: 1
    - name: charge_cost
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: multiplier
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: family
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - add_stress
      - clear_interference
      required: true
    effects:
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_cost
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.name
        value: program
    - set:
        field: state.last_program.result
        value: amount * multiplier
    - condition: family == 'clear_interference'
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.conditions.interference
          value: false
    - condition: family == 'add_stress'
      on_true:
      - increment:
          field: state.stress
          amount: 1
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
      visible_to_player: false
  resolve_intrusion:
    description: Resolve a noncombat Intrusion operation with two six-sided dice.
    parameters: false
    effects:
    - dice:
        expression: 2d6
      store_as: _operation_roll
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.skill
        value: skill
    - set:
        field: state.last_check.total
        value: _operation_roll.total
    - condition: _operation_roll.total >= pressure
      on_true:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: clear
      on_false:
      - set:
          field: state.last_check.outcome
          value: compromised
    metadata:
      category: noncombat_resolution
      costs_action: false
  apply_operation_cost:
    description: Commit package-owned Stress, Wounds, charge, condition, and advancement.
    parameters:
    - name: stress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: wounds
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: charge_spent
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    - name: progress
      type: integer
      minimum: 0
      required: true
    effects:
    - increment:
        field: state.stress
        amount: stress
    - increment:
        field: state.wounds
        amount: wounds
    - decrement:
        field: state.resources.charge
        amount: charge_spent
    - set:
        field: state.conditions.interference
        value: true
    - increment:
        field: state.advancement.intrusion
        amount: progress
    metadata:
      category: consequence
      costs_action: false
  run_program:
    description: Run one package-declared signal program without core-specific mechanics.
    parameters:
    - name: program
      type: enum
      enum_values:
      - ghost_route
      - signal_boost
      required: true
    - name: amount
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      required: true
    effects:
    - table_lookup:
        table: definitions.programs
        key: program
        required: true
        exact_selector: true
      store_as: _definition
    - set:
        field: _definition_key
        value: program
    - set:
        field: _definition_table
        value: programs
    - call: commit_program
      params:
        program: '{program}'
        amount: '{amount}'
        charge_cost: '{_definition.charge_cost}'
        multiplier: '{_definition.multiplier}'
        family: '{_definition.family}'
    metadata:
      category: signal_program
      costs_action: false
procedures: {}
definition_row_schemas:
  definitions.programs:
    discriminator: family
    variants:
      add_stress:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
      clear_interference:
        type: object
        properties:
          charge_cost:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            maximum: 5
          multiplier:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 5
        required:
        - charge_cost
        - multiplier
        additionalProperties: false
definitions:
  programs:
    ghost_route:
      charge_cost: 3
      family: clear_interference
      multiplier: 1
    signal_boost:
      charge_cost: 2
      family: add_stress
      multiplier: 3
narrative: {}
